elements.requirement: An employer terminating the contract of employment of a person continuously employed for one month or more must give not less than one week’s notice if that person's period of continuous employment is less than two years.
elements.quote: is not less than one week’s notice if his period of continuous employment is less than two years

elements.requirement: An employer terminating the contract of employment of a person continuously employed for one month or more must give not less than one week’s notice for each year of continuous employment if that person's period of continuous employment is two years or more but less than twelve years.
elements.quote: is not less than one week’s notice for each year of continuous employment if his period of continuous employment is two years or more but less than twelve years

elements.requirement: An employer terminating the contract of employment of a person continuously employed for one month or more must give not less than twelve weeks’ notice if that person's period of continuous employment is twelve years or more.
elements.quote: is not less than twelve weeks’ notice if his period of continuous employment is twelve years or more

elements.requirement: An employee who has been continuously employed for one month or more must give not less than one week's notice to terminate their contract of employment.
elements.quote: The notice required to be given by an employee who has been continuously employed for one month or more to terminate his contract of employment is not less than one week.

elements.requirement: Any contractual provision for shorter notice in a contract of employment with a person continuously employed for one month or more is subject to the statutory minimum notice periods required of employers and employees.
elements.quote: Any provision for shorter notice in any contract of employment with a person who has been continuously employed for one month or more has effect subject to subsections (1) and (2)

elements.requirement: Either party to an employment contract is permitted to waive their right to notice on any occasion.
elements.quote: this section does not prevent either party from waiving his right to notice on any occasion

elements.requirement: Either party to an employment contract is permitted to accept a payment in lieu of notice.
elements.quote: or from accepting a payment in lieu of notice

elements.requirement: A contract of employment for a term certain of one month or less takes effect as if it were for an indefinite period, and triggers the statutory minimum notice rules, if the employee has been continuously employed for three months or more.
elements.quote: contract of employment of a person who has been continuously employed for three months or more which is a contract for a term certain of one month or less shall have effect as if it were for an indefinite period; and, accordingly, subsections (1) and (2) apply to the contract

elements.requirement: Either party to a contract of employment retains the right to treat the contract as terminable without notice by reason of the other party's conduct.
elements.quote: This section does not affect any right of either party to a contract of employment to treat the contract as terminable without notice by reason of the conduct of the other party.
